title: 第14章 宣传开始
content_zh:
陆穿的电影，经过一个月的剪辑，终于完成，定档2月2日。

    谷川在陆穿忙剪辑的这段时间，也搞定了自己剧组的事情，剧本已经过审，幕后、演员、投资、和一些杂七杂八的小事，全都搞定了。

    可以一心一意帮陆穿运营奖项了。

    “可以开始宣传了。”

    谷川说道：“咱们可以把《女巫布莱克》在好莱坞的宣传，直接移植到中国来。”

    “它在好莱坞是怎么宣传的？”

    谷川面不改色地说道：“一个人先在往上发帖，说他的一个朋友，在寻找女巫的时候失踪了，这是朋友留下的录像带。”

    “这点，我们完全可以移植过来，在天涯社区、猫扑或各大高校的BBS的“灵异怪谈”版块发帖子，例如《我朋友去热河某深山探险失踪了，这是他们留下的最后录像带》。”

    王忠磊认真地听着。

    谷川咳嗽一声：“当然，我只是建议而已，你们完全不用听我的。”

    “你继续说。”王忠磊说道。

    好莱坞的先进经验，这个得学。

    谷川又轻声说道：“他们建立了一个假的官方网站，伪造警方证据，把这件事情包装成了一个真的。”

    他看了一眼王忠磊，表情十分严肃地说道：“这个可不要学，可能是违法的。”

    “放心。”王忠磊笑着说道：“我又没疯，当然不会主动违法。”

    “这样就好。”谷川担心地说道：“我怕你真把好莱坞的糟粕给学去了，祸害中国电影。”

    王忠磊笑了笑。

    他又不傻，怎么可能会做这种事。

    看到他面无异常，谷川继续说道：“他们伪造主演失踪，在线下到处张贴寻人启事，尤其是在年轻人多的地方，也十分注重网上的传播。”

    谷川对着王忠磊劝道：“但我感觉这样并不好，这是在骗人。”

    王忠磊嗤笑一声。

    骗人怎么了？

    他感觉谷川还是太年轻了，就算是从小在美国长大又怎么了，还是太嫩了，连骗人都有羞耻心。

    而且王忠磊的脑子里，已经想好在国内的宣传方案了。

    就说是陆穿、刘若瑛和刘晔失踪了。

    几个普通人失踪，和两个演员一个导演失踪，那造成的效果是不一样的，肯定会更轰动。

    谷川继续说道：“而且这部电影，在好莱坞是没有发过任何商业宣传片的，都当是真实录像带。
content_en:
Lu Chuan's movie is finally completed after a month of editing and is scheduled to be released on February 2.

    While Lu Chuan was busy editing, Tanichuan also settled matters with his own crew. The script had been reviewed, and all the behind-the-scenes, actors, investment, and other miscellaneous matters were settled.

    Now I can help Lu Chuan run the awards wholeheartedly.

    "We can start promoting it."

    Tanigawa said: "We can directly transplant the promotion of "Black Witch" in Hollywood to China."

    “How is it promoted in Hollywood?”

    Tanikawa said without changing his expression: "A person posted online first, saying that one of his friends disappeared while searching for a witch. This is a videotape left by his friend."

    "We can completely transplant this and post in the "Supernatural Stories" section of Tianya Community, Maopu or BBS in major universities, such as "My friend went missing while exploring a deep mountain in Rehe, and this is the last video tape they left behind."

    Wang Zhonglei listened carefully.

    Tanichuan coughed: "Of course, I'm just a suggestion, you don't have to listen to me at all."

    "Keep talking." Wang Zhonglei said.

    Hollywood’s advanced experience, this has to be learned.

    Tanichuan said softly: "They set up a fake official website, forged police evidence, and packaged this matter as real."

    He glanced at Wang Zhonglei and said with a very serious expression: "Don't learn this, it may be illegal."

    "Don't worry." Wang Zhonglei said with a smile: "I'm not crazy. Of course I won't take the initiative to break the law."

    "That's good." Tanichuan said worriedly: "I'm afraid you will really learn the dregs of Hollywood and harm Chinese movies."

    Wang Zhonglei smiled.

    He is not stupid, how could he do such a thing.

    Seeing that his face was normal, Tanigawa continued: "They faked the disappearance of the leading actor and posted missing person notices everywhere offline, especially in places with many young people, and also paid great attention to online dissemination."

    Gu Chuan advised Wang Zhonglei: "But I feel that this is not good. This is a lie."

    Wang Zhonglei sneered.

    What happened to lying?

    He felt that Tanichuan was still too young. Even if he grew up in the United States, he was still too young and even felt ashamed to lie to others.

    Moreover, Wang Zhonglei has already thought of a publicity plan in the country.

    Just say that Lu Chuan, Liu Ruoying and Liu Ye were missing.

    The disappearance of a few ordinary people will have a different effect than the disappearance of two actors and a director, and it will definitely be more sensational.

    Tanigawa continued: “Furthermore, this movie has not been released in any commercial promotions in Hollywood, it is treated as a real video tape.
